notes.title: Fast way of communication
notes.notes:
I have my own Discord server where we can quickly communicate and talk about favorite topics. There I write about events from my life and about the development of my projects. If many people are interested, it will be possible to expand it and add new sections. If you're also trying to make your own game, I might be able to tell you something. 

What are the reasons to switch to my server? 
1. Fast communication. 
2. The opportunity to find like-minded people. 
3. Just a nice place. 
4. Pizza? 

Below is how to do it with one click of the mouse button. 
Oh and yes, you must have Discord installed or you can use the online version, enough chatter let's get started!

notes.title: Do not rush
notes.notes:
Hello, I understand that it is not acceptable to buy games of this scale made by one person. But please try to play at least half of it, don't rush to return it and write that you bought it by accident. All you need for a successful start is to immediately go to the high shed where the energy printer is in Guta, climb the ladder up and take the energy rod. Then go down to the energy printer and take the energy regeneration modification as the first thing.
Then the game will go at a much faster pace. Of course, this is my miscalculation and insufficient number of testers, but I ask you, try to play it. You can follow the timer of the recorded time so that later you can return it if you don't like it, but I ask you to go at least to the middle. And one more thing, please leave a review because I can't understand what you didn't like, thank you.

Offtop
It seems that different people write to me in order to ask for a key to the game, not a review. But the links they give to the streamers they want to be lead to channels that have not been active for more than three years. Or on YouTube channels that do not have contact information, such as an email, so that I cannot check whether it is this person or not. And even three different people wrote with links to their sites for reviews that were made according to the same template and on which there is no organic activity, and the links to their social networks do not lead anywhere.

Yes, so what am I leading to? If you ever develop your games, don't fall for such a scam and check everything thoroughly. Thank you for attention.
